I've been a little overwhelmed since I have a lot of different things that I'm doing so I'm looking to hire someone full time, a paid intern.
Ideally, someone who wants to learn about business or someone that's really interested in the health and nutrition space. To Apply:

1. Film a horizontal video and answer the following questions:
a. Tell me about yourself
b. Why do you want this job?
c. Why should I hire you?
d. What is your favorite book?
e. If you can have a conversation with anybody, living or dead, who would it be and why?

2. Send me an email at travis@effectiveecommerce.com, attach the video and on the subject line write "I want to work for you".

3. Deadline of submission is until March 1.
